detail: Decisions: Chose to read legacy scopeless handoff records as scope "project" in both list filters and to default createHandoff's scope to "project" — supersedes the deliberate preservation of optional-scope behavior from the scopeMatches extraction: that preservation kept the bidirectional-startsWith empty-string universal match, which field D12 measured as a 15-day-old blocked item surfacing in every narrow-scope assemble; the tool schema had documented the project default all along
summary: Wave A: legacy scopeless handoffs now read as scope "project" in both backends' list filters, and createHandoff applies its documented default — closes the D12 universal-match leak.
